grades.reason: Covers hedeleg/hideleg delegation from HS-mode to VS-mode in the H extension. It does not say how software discovers which exceptions medeleg can delegate to S-mode.
Describes where traps are routed and which CSRs are written on trap entry. It gives no method for discovering which medeleg bits are delegatable.

grades.quote: An implementation can choose to subset the delegatable traps, with the supported delegatable bits found by writing one to every bit location, then reading back the value in `medeleg` or `mideleg` to see which bit positions hold a one.
grades.reason: States directly that software finds the supported delegatable bits by writing ones to every bit of medeleg and reading the value back. It also notes that implementations may subset the delegatable traps.
This is a changelog preface. Its only medeleg mention is that the registers do not exist in some configurations, which does not explain how to discover delegatable exceptions.
